_comment: The steam gate was COUNTER_GTE amount 0 -- 'at least zero counters', true for every card at all times -- so 'if there are NO steam counters' let you put a counter on whatever the count already was, and the pistol's attack ability could be recharged without limit. COUNTER_EQ exists precisely for this (it was added when Teklo Core was found destroying itself every turn for the same reason); this card was missed. The unread 'target': 'self' is dropped: the condition reads the card carrying it.
